prerequisites: Actual full source/fallback and strict formatter bridges on the final immutable three-file candidate.
Fresh error-level types and Ruff; exact23 baseline/candidate existing collections;23 existing plus22 new bodies with full phase/JUnit reconciliation.
Six separately labelled opcode cells with exact original/candidate source-bound counts and object-order parity.
Root freeze of applicable RSP-012 tranche, real baseline artifact and workload/cell choices before timings; unchanged original selection thresholds.

original_requirements.selection: RSP-012 must declare the applicable original PRD go/no-go boundary before timing. A selected hot-path claim requires the existing >=30% p95 or process-tree CPU benefit and <=5% regression in the other primary metric when that tranche definition applies; this proposal does not silently substitute a microbenchmark for it.
original_requirements.resource_and_qualification: The original full route counts, matching baseline artifacts, five independent runs, resource observations and uncertainty remain required in their stated scopes. This microexperiment does not substitute for those requirements.

algorithms.baseline: Compile the exact original AnnAssign+For AST copied from actual baseline sync_aibom_snapshots into a two-argument wrapper with only a final return appended.
algorithms.candidate: Compile the exact actual helper-call Assign+If AST from the final candidate sync_aibom_snapshots into the same wrapper shape with only the final return appended.
algorithms.globals: Each child imports only its selected immutable product checkout; wrapper globals are that actual module's globals. Preserve the actual tuple binding/helper lookup, guard, list grouping, tuple materialization and fallback costs. No monkeypatch or substitute data class in the timed arm.
algorithms.assertions: Before timing, prove wrapper statement ASTs equal those exact complete-file ranges, actual helper identity/source, original and candidate class source equivalence, and no tracer/profiler. Outside timing compare ordered keys and each source-ordinal occurrence, including duplicates.

process_protocol.owned_environment: Exact CPython3.12.13 and frozen69-distribution closure, same pinned tool/environment source; explicit isolated checkout origins. No unrelated worker overlaps.
process_protocol.run_retention: Preserve both arms even when one regresses or fails. Record every raw sample, process return/timeout, final original-group retirement, source/environment identity and observations. No successful-only selection, unreported reruns or pool across workload cells.
process_protocol.timing_instrumentation: No sys.settrace/sys.setprofile, tracing, opcode callback, allocation tracer, source reading, serialization, comparisons, assertions or fixture construction inside timed boundaries. Record wall perf_counter_ns and process_time_ns around identical numbers of actual joins. Counter observations remain a separate process.

cells.diagnostic_scope: The actual sync caller returns before this join when snapshots are empty. This standalone helper cell diagnoses guard/index overhead and is not a claimed reachable default route.

cells.key_population: 4096 distinct source keys, all unequal to the one snapshot key
4096 distinct source keys, all unequal to every snapshot key

input_protocol.warm_mode: Each arm owns its own equal-valued population and receives exactly one untimed complete join before measured reuse.
input_protocol.no_cross_arm_aliasing: Build baseline/candidate records and strings separately, using the same deterministic ordinal recipes. Never reuse a baseline-hashed population in the candidate arm. Within each cold alias cell use lists/index positions, not a dict or set that prehashes keys during setup.
input_protocol.key_validation: Check source/type/length/value recipes without calling hash or using string-keyed dict/set before the first cold measurement. Verify identity/alias maps via integer ordinals. All source IDs are synthetic public test data.
input_protocol.lifetime: Keep the returned result alive through the stop timestamps; verify output afterward and retire before next sample. Both arms follow the same construction/result/retirement order.
input_protocol.duplicate_semantics: Report M, the sum of matched tuple entries over snapshot occurrences, separately from S/P. Duplicate snapshot keys must keep last overwrite, original insertion order and tuple source occurrences. No deduplication.
input_protocol.API_scope: Fresh exact frozen-record API, exact str keys and supported provider/callback changes completed before the join. No concurrent raw object.__setattr__/class mutation is introduced into the performance premise. Rejected accessor/container/factory cases retain original fallback and are covered by the separate finite controls.
input_protocol.unmatched_scope: These explicit unmatched-source cells diagnose grouping costs, including keys the result never uses. The current stock caller filters sources before the join; the supported event/batch callback may change records afterward. Diagnostic cells are not asserted to represent normal filtered production populations.

metrics.limits: Twenty samples per cell per independent arm are diagnostic and cannot establish original route tail qualification. Process CPU here covers this one join process only; no process-tree attribution to scanner/cloud children.
metrics.resources: Any Python allocation observation is a separate untimed campaign, explicitly Python heap rather than process RSS/private memory. Required process-tree/private-memory metrics remain null until actually observed in the full workload.

temporary_groups.campaign: Separate instrumented diagnostic children; never enable instrumentation in timed arms.
temporary_groups.candidate: Bind the actual helper code filename/source hash, then observe its return frame. Record lengths of snapshot_ids/source_ids, number of grouped keys, summed grouped list entries, and returned result/tuple entry counts without retaining record payloads or keys.
temporary_groups.baseline: Observe the exact original wrapper return; record returned result/tuple entry counts and absence of candidate-only grouping containers.
temporary_groups.collection_controls: Compare all actual returned identities to the uninstrumented oracle and retain exact source/environment before-after. Any unavailable frame/count remains missing and fails the diagnostic instead of being inferred from S/P.
temporary_groups.footprint: If shallow container sizes or tracemalloc are added, run them in a separate untimed cell and label the exact CPython container/Python-heap scope. No implied RSS, retained-memory, process-tree or physical allocation claim.
temporary_groups.empty_set_boundary: With S=0/P=128, original loop performs no source key reads; the candidate still validates and indexes source keys. Measure that overhead and the actual temporary group population; do not preemptively edit the helper or invent a threshold.

whole_workload_followthrough.scenarios: The existing source-bound24/128/486-file incremental inventory scenarios; these are file counts, not a claim of that many workspaces or snapshots.
whole_workload_followthrough.original_behavior: Keep actual traversal/upserts, ACK acceptance predicate, retries, client_unverified provenance and all SQL commit behavior. Keep the previously observed five-write regression visible. Missing real scanner/cloud routes remain unavailable.
whole_workload_followthrough.selection: Choose no production threshold or optimization until these controlled measurements and the original applicable go/no-go requirements are met. A micro speedup or opcode reduction alone is insufficient.

failure_policy: Retain original production nested join if benefit is immaterial or a predeclared small-input/resource nonregression requirement fails. A future size threshold would be a new measured selection proposal with its own source/tests, not retroactively inferred from these results.
